title: Chest pain
plain: Chest pain or pressure can be the heart. Rest, call for help and give aspirin unless something rules it out.

doNotGive.reason: Ibuprofen can make heart damage worse

steps.text: Stop all activity. Sit down and loosen tight clothing.
Call the crew medical officer now.

steps.question: Any face drooping, arm weakness, slurred speech or sudden confusion?

steps.text: Do not give aspirin: with stroke signs it can make a bleed in the brain worse. Start the stroke steps.

steps.detail: Aspirin thins the blood and can limit damage if this is the heart.

steps.text: Measure oxygen saturation. Below 94%: give oxygen by the onboard checklist.

steps.question: Is the pain gone and is breathing normal?
steps.detail: Measure heart rate and blood pressure each time.

steps.text: Rest for the rest of the day with a crewmate close by. Report any new pain at once.

escalation: Pain lasting more than 20 minutes, fainting or trouble breathing: follow EMG-CHEST-PAIN with the CMO (oxygen, monitoring, the cardiac checklist). Earth is informed.
